verdict.rationale: Orb has a documented API with cursor-paginated list endpoints, SDKs in six languages, cached query responses, and an llms.txt, so an agent could plausibly query billing data. Revenue tracking, recognized/deferred revenue, and dunning retries are documented as product features, but no evidence shows these exposed as agent-queryable endpoints. No agent-specific access path, such as an MCP server or agent tooling, is documented, and the OpenAPI probes returned 404, which makes it harder to auto-generate agent tools. Missing for 10: an official MCP server or agent integration, documented query endpoints for MRR, delinquent accounts and upcoming renewals, explicit per-customer invoice listing, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent querying.
